keywords.indexterm: automatic climate control system automatic air ventilation

conbody.p: When operating heater and air conditioner for the vehicle ventilation, if you maintain the Recirculation mode for 30 minutes or over at low temperature, it automatically changes to Fresh mode.

li.p: Select SettingsVehicleClimateAutomatic ventilationAuto dehumidify on the Infotainment System screen.

section.title: Operation
section.p: Select SettingsVehicleClimateAutomatic ventilationAuto dehumidify to activate or deactivate from the Settings menu in the Infotainment System screen. The “REC” indicator blinks 6 times in 0.25 second of intervals.
To cancel or reset the automatic ventilation:

li.p: Touch the recirculated air position icon more than five times within 3 seconds.
The “REC” indicator blinks 3 times in 0.5 second of intervals.

section.p: The infotainment system may change after software updates. For more information, refer to the manual provided in the infotainment system and the quick reference guide.
